// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Lista de Auditoria"

//Report Template Source
	

	//Code block: AssignAppInfo
	&AppName = WWP_GetSystemParameter(!"AD_Application_Name")
	&Phone = WWP_GetSystemParameter(!"AD_Application_Phone")
	&Mail = WWP_GetSystemParameter(!"AD_Application_Mail")
	&Website = WWP_GetSystemParameter(!"AD_Application_Website")
	&AddressLine1 = WWP_GetSystemParameter(!"AD_Application_Address")
	&AddressLine2 = WWP_GetSystemParameter(!"AD_Application_Neighbour")
	&AddressLine3 = WWP_GetSystemParameter(!"AD_Application_CityAndCountry")



	

Header
	Print printTitle
End 
Footer
	&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
	&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
	Print printFooter
End

Do 'PrintFilters'

Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

Do 'PrintData'

Do 'PrintFooter'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If &GridState.DynamicFilters.Count >= 1
		&GridStateDynamicFilter = &GridState.DynamicFilters.Item(1)
		&DynamicFiltersSelector1 = &GridStateDynamicFilter.Selected
		Do Case
			Case &DynamicFiltersSelector1 = !'AUDITORIATRN'
				&DynamicFiltersOperator1 = &GridStateDynamicFilter.Operator
				&AuditoriaTRN1.FromString(&GridStateDynamicFilter.Value)
				If not &AuditoriaTRN1.IsEmpty()
					Do Case
						Case &DynamicFiltersOperator1 = 0
							&FilterAuditoriaTRNDescription = format('%1 (%2)', "Transaccion", "WWP_FilterLike")
						Case &DynamicFiltersOperator1 = 1
							&FilterAuditoriaTRNDescription = format('%1 (%2)', "Transaccion", "WWP_FilterContains")
					EndCase
					&AuditoriaTRN = &AuditoriaTRN1
					print printBlockFilterAuditoriaTRN
				EndIf			
		EndCase
		If &GridState.DynamicFilters.Count >= 2
			&DynamicFiltersEnabled2 = True
			&GridStateDynamicFilter = &GridState.DynamicFilters.Item(2)
			&DynamicFiltersSelector2 = &GridStateDynamicFilter.Selected
			Do Case
				Case &DynamicFiltersSelector2 = !'AUDITORIATRN'
					&DynamicFiltersOperator2 = &GridStateDynamicFilter.Operator
					&AuditoriaTRN2.FromString(&GridStateDynamicFilter.Value)
					If not &AuditoriaTRN2.IsEmpty()
						Do Case
							Case &DynamicFiltersOperator2 = 0
								&FilterAuditoriaTRNDescription = format('%1 (%2)', "Transaccion", "WWP_FilterLike")
							Case &DynamicFiltersOperator2 = 1
								&FilterAuditoriaTRNDescription = format('%1 (%2)', "Transaccion", "WWP_FilterContains")
						EndCase
						&AuditoriaTRN = &AuditoriaTRN2
						print printBlockFilterAuditoriaTRN
					EndIf			
			EndCase
			If &GridState.DynamicFilters.Count >= 3
				&DynamicFiltersEnabled3 = True
				&GridStateDynamicFilter = &GridState.DynamicFilters.Item(3)
				&DynamicFiltersSelector3 = &GridStateDynamicFilter.Selected
				Do Case
					Case &DynamicFiltersSelector3 = !'AUDITORIATRN'
						&DynamicFiltersOperator3 = &GridStateDynamicFilter.Operator
						&AuditoriaTRN3.FromString(&GridStateDynamicFilter.Value)
						If not &AuditoriaTRN3.IsEmpty()
							Do Case
								Case &DynamicFiltersOperator3 = 0
									&FilterAuditoriaTRNDescription = format('%1 (%2)', "Transaccion", "WWP_FilterLike")
								Case &DynamicFiltersOperator3 = 1
									&FilterAuditoriaTRNDescription = format('%1 (%2)', "Transaccion", "WWP_FilterContains")
							EndCase
							&AuditoriaTRN = &AuditoriaTRN3
							print printBlockFilterAuditoriaTRN
						EndIf			
				EndCase
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFAuditoriaTRN_Sel.IsEmpty()
		&TempBoolean = (&TFAuditoriaTRN_Sel = !'<#Empty#>')
		&TFAuditoriaTRN_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, 'WWP_TitleFilter_EmptyOption', &TFAuditoriaTRN_Sel)
		print printBlockTFAuditoriaTRN_Sel
		&TFAuditoriaTRN_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, !'<#Empty#>', &TFAuditoriaTRN_Sel)
	Else
		If not &TFAuditoriaTRN.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFAuditoriaTRN
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFAuditoriaPK_Sel.IsEmpty()
		&TempBoolean = (&TFAuditoriaPK_Sel = !'<#Empty#>')
		&TFAuditoriaPK_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, 'WWP_TitleFilter_EmptyOption', &TFAuditoriaPK_Sel)
		print printBlockTFAuditoriaPK_Sel
		&TFAuditoriaPK_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, !'<#Empty#>', &TFAuditoriaPK_Sel)
	Else
		If not &TFAuditoriaPK.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFAuditoriaPK
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFAuditoriaATTR_Sel.IsEmpty()
		&TempBoolean = (&TFAuditoriaATTR_Sel = !'<#Empty#>')
		&TFAuditoriaATTR_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, 'WWP_TitleFilter_EmptyOption', &TFAuditoriaATTR_Sel)
		print printBlockTFAuditoriaATTR_Sel
		&TFAuditoriaATTR_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, !'<#Empty#>', &TFAuditoriaATTR_Sel)
	Else
		If not &TFAuditoriaATTR.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFAuditoriaATTR
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFAuditoriaOldValue_Sel.IsEmpty()
		&TempBoolean = (&TFAuditoriaOldValue_Sel = !'<#Empty#>')
		&TFAuditoriaOldValue_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, 'WWP_TitleFilter_EmptyOption', &TFAuditoriaOldValue_Sel)
		print printBlockTFAuditoriaOldValue_Sel
		&TFAuditoriaOldValue_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, !'<#Empty#>', &TFAuditoriaOldValue_Sel)
	Else
		If not &TFAuditoriaOldValue.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFAuditoriaOldValue
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFAuditoriaValue_Sel.IsEmpty()
		&TempBoolean = (&TFAuditoriaValue_Sel = !'<#Empty#>')
		&TFAuditoriaValue_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, 'WWP_TitleFilter_EmptyOption', &TFAuditoriaValue_Sel)
		print printBlockTFAuditoriaValue_Sel
		&TFAuditoriaValue_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, !'<#Empty#>', &TFAuditoriaValue_Sel)
	Else
		If not &TFAuditoriaValue.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFAuditoriaValue
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&TFAuditoriaMode_Sels.FromJson(&TFAuditoriaMode_SelsJson)
	If not &TFAuditoriaMode_Sels.Count = 0
		&i = 1
		For &TFAuditoriaMode_Sel in &TFAuditoriaMode_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&TFAuditoriaMode_SelDscs = ''
			Else
				&TFAuditoriaMode_SelDscs += ', '
			EndIf
			

			&TFAuditoriaMode_SelDscs += &FilterTFAuditoriaMode_SelValueDescription
			&i += 1
		EndFor
		print printBlockTFAuditoriaMode_Sel
	EndIf
	If not &TFAuditoriaUser_Sel.IsEmpty()
		&TempBoolean = (&TFAuditoriaUser_Sel = !'<#Empty#>')
		&TFAuditoriaUser_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, 'WWP_TitleFilter_EmptyOption', &TFAuditoriaUser_Sel)
		print printBlockTFAuditoriaUser_Sel
		&TFAuditoriaUser_Sel = iif(&TempBoolean, !'<#Empty#>', &TFAuditoriaUser_Sel)
	Else
		If not &TFAuditoriaUser.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFAuditoriaUser
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditoriaDateTime.IsEmpty() AND &TFAuditoriaDateTime_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFAuditoriaDateTime
		&TFAuditoriaDateTime_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "del Evento", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFAuditoriaDateTime_To
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each Auditoria
		order AuditoriaTRN  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditoriaTRN)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditoriaPK  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditoriaPK)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditoriaATTR  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditoriaATTR)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditoriaOldValue  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditoriaOldValue)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditoriaValue  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditoriaValue)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditoriaMode  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditoriaMode)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditoriaUser  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditoriaUser)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditoriaDateTime  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditoriaDateTime)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using AuditoriaWWDS(&FilterFullText, &DynamicFiltersSelector1, &DynamicFiltersOperator1, &AuditoriaTRN1, &DynamicFiltersEnabled2, &DynamicFiltersSelector2
					, &DynamicFiltersOperator2, &AuditoriaTRN2, &DynamicFiltersEnabled3, &DynamicFiltersSelector3, &DynamicFiltersOperator3, &AuditoriaTRN3
					, &TFAuditoriaTRN, &TFAuditoriaTRN_Sel, &TFAuditoriaPK, &TFAuditoriaPK_Sel, &TFAuditoriaATTR, &TFAuditoriaATTR_Sel
					, &TFAuditoriaOldValue, &TFAuditoriaOldValue_Sel, &TFAuditoriaValue, &TFAuditoriaValue_Sel, &TFAuditoriaMode_Sels, &TFAuditoriaUser
					, &TFAuditoriaUser_Sel, &TFAuditoriaDateTime, &TFAuditoriaDateTime_To)
		

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Auditoria.AuditoriaWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Auditoria.AuditoriaWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Auditoria.AuditoriaWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIATRN"
				&TFAuditoriaTRN.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIATRN_SEL"
				&TFAuditoriaTRN_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAPK"
				&TFAuditoriaPK.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAPK_SEL"
				&TFAuditoriaPK_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAATTR"
				&TFAuditoriaATTR.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAATTR_SEL"
				&TFAuditoriaATTR_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAOLDVALUE"
				&TFAuditoriaOldValue.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAOLDVALUE_SEL"
				&TFAuditoriaOldValue_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAVALUE"
				&TFAuditoriaValue.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAVALUE_SEL"
				&TFAuditoriaValue_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAMODE_SEL"
				&TFAuditoriaMode_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFAuditoriaMode_Sels.FromJson(&TFAuditoriaMode_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAUSER"
				&TFAuditoriaUser.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIAUSER_SEL"
				&TFAuditoriaUser_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITORIADATETIME"
				&TFAuditoriaDateTime.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFAuditoriaDateTime_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
